items.text: Otini kiwonyö sömewö, kïlenchï ECHOTYON Musa nko Eleasar wero Aron,
“Yitö pipö Israel löwïr kïpeghategha ortïn, mïrön cho tïng könyis tömönut odeny kutok, cho kikumï kïpa poryot.”
Kilenyona kïmwochï Musa nko Eleasar nyay le tïsin chane, ompö tömköyi Moap ompö Yeriko ato lekïto Yordan lö,
“Yitö mïrön nyo tïng könyis tömönut odeny kutok lenyini kimwochï ECHOTYON Musa.” Kituyechï chane mpöghoghyo Moap atoriktoy Yordan ompö Yeriko. Pipö Israel cho kipkana koro Misri kï chï.
Pipö ara Rupen poretya Yakopo kï: pipö ara Anok nko Palu
nko Esron nko Karmi.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 43,730.
Pipö ara Palu kï Elyap
nko werkachi, Nemuel nko Datan nko Apiram. Datan nko Apiram chay kikïl pich, chane chay kitagh Musa nko Aron akïnamata kegh nko pipö Kora atay kitagh chane ECHOTYON.
Kiyata ngwïnya akulum chane nko Kora nko pikachi ato kipel ma mïrön 250, kïlïkwï chane kiporunöt ompö pich.
Wölo melö kikïpar werpö Kora.
Pipö ara Simion kï: pipö ara Nemuel nko Yamin nko Yakin
nko Sera nko Syaul.
Kïlïkwï chane mïrön 22,200.
Pipö ara Kad kï: werpö ara Sepon nko Aki nko Syuni
nko Osni nko Eri
nko Arod nko Areli.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 40,500.
Pipö ara Yuda kï: werpö ara Syela nko pipö Peres nko Sera nko Esron nko Amul. Kökikuwonyechï Er nko Onan werpö Yuda koro Kanan.
Kilïkwï pïchoni pö ara Yuda mïrön 76,500.
Pipö ara Isakar kï: werpö ara Tola nko Pua
nko Yasyup nyo pö ara Yasyup nko Syimron nyo pö ara pipö Syimron.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 64,300.
Pipö ara Saplon kï: pipö ara Sered nko Elon nko Yaaleel.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 60,500.
Pipö ara Yosep kï: Manase nko Epraim.
Pipö ara Manase kï: Makir, kiyï Makir Kiliad.
Pipö ara Kiliad kï: pipö ara Iyeser nko Elek
nko Asriel nko Syekem
nko Syemida nko Eper.
Kimöyïnye worö Selopead wero Eper, wölo kiyï tipïn, kaynötutkökwa kï: Mala nko Noa nko Okla nko Milka nko Tirsa.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 52,700.
Pipö ara Epraim kï: pipö ara Syutela nko Peker nko Taan.
Kiyï Syutela pipö ara Eran.
Kilïkwï pipö ara Epraim mïrön 32,500.
Achï nyu pipö ara Yosep.
Pipö ara Penchamen kï: pipö ara Pela nko Aspel nko Airam
nko Syepuam nko Upam.
Kiyï Pela pipö ara Ard nko Naaman.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 45,600.
Pipö ara Dan kï: pipö ara Syuam.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 64,400.
Pipö ara Asyer kï: pipö ara Imna nko Ispi nko Peria.
Kiyï Peria pipö ara Eper nko Malkiel.
Kitïng Asyer cheptanyi nyo kikïkuro Sera.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 53,400.
Pipö ara Naptali kï: pipö ara Yaaseel nko Kuni,
nko Yeser nko Syilem.
Kilïkwï chane mïrön 45,900.
Pipö Israel löwïr cho le mïrön kï 601,730.
Kïlenchï ECHOTYON Musa,
“Chöghchinö koronï ortïna pipö Israel kïrïp kegh nko kiyitötengwa.
Ichagh kore ompö kura, itö kore nyo wow pich cho chang itö nyo mïnïng pich cho ngörï kïrïp kegh nko kiyitötengwa.”
Pipö Lawi kï pipö ara Kersyon nko Koat nko Merari.
Chï kï pipö ara Lawi tïkwïl: pipö ara Lipni nko Epron nko Mali nko Musyi nko Kora. Koat kï papoto Amram.
Kaynata koko Amram kï Yokeped nyo kikïyichï Misri. Kiyichï Amram wor odeny, Aron nko Musa nko cheptö nyo kïkuro Miriam.
Kiy 3:2
Kitïng Aron wor angwan, Nadap nko Apiu nko Eleasar nko Itamar.
Kiy 3:4
Wölo kima Nadap nko Apiu otini kiropchï ECHOTYON ma nyo melö tïlil.
Monïngo pipö Lawi cho le wor cho kitïng arawa akonga kutok kï ki 23,000 kikiyit chane kïsis ompö pipö Israel, ompöwölo melö tïng chane mïlat ompö kwenu pipö Israel.
Kiyit Musa nko Eleasar ortïnechï löwïr pö pipö Israel ompö mpöghoghöyi Moap atoriktoy lalwa Yordan ompö Yeriko.
Möminye chi ompö akong nyo kingötï ompö pïchay kiyit Musa nko Aron surkwen pö Sinay.
Ompöwölo kökilö ECHOTYON meghsot chane löwïr ompö surkwen, kïpoto Kalep wero Yepune nko Yoswö wero Nun.
Tipö Selopead
